about_item: Pet-Perfect Design: Discover the ultimate relaxation for your pet with our Sherpa Plush Mat! Its classic shape melds seamlessly with our signature design, offering ample space for your furry friend to stretch and snooze in style. Perfect for any home decor, it's a breeze to move around, making it a cozy spot for your pet indoors, outdoors, in a crate, or during travel adventures.

Adorable and Versatile Style: Add a sprinkle of charm to any room with our dog bed's delightful design, available in a variety of colors. Not just a comfy haven for your pet, this chic and puffy-shaped bed effortlessly enhances the ambiance of your bedroom, living room, or balcony with its soothing presence.

Orthopedic Comfort for Blissful Slumbers: Engineered for comfort, our bed provides exceptional orthopedic support. The high-density egg-crate foam evenly distributes weight, offering optimal pressure relief. This design helps ease joint pain and alleviate arthritis discomfort, ensuring your pet enjoys a restful, therapeutic sleep.

Secure and Stable Design: The Sherpa Plush Mat stays exactly where you place it, thanks to its non-slip bottom. This thoughtful feature offers a secure and stable resting area for your pet, enhancing their sense of safety and peace.

Hassle-Free Maintenance: Our pet bed boasts a removable cover that's not only durable but also resistant to stains, making cleaning a simple task. Just machine wash and tumble dry! Plus, the waterproof liner shields the inner foam, prolonging the bed's lifespan and maintaining its freshness.

authors_reviews.title: Perfect Elevated Dog Bed — Stylish, Comfortable & Easy to Clean!
authors_reviews.text: I’m so happy with this dog — the design and quality have exceeded my expectations! The material feels great and the style fits seamlessly with my home aesthetic. I put it in my office so my dogs would have a cozy spot to lay while I’m working, and it looks elevated and chic rather than bulky like many dog beds.The best part for me is how easy it is to keep clean — I can take the cover off and toss it in the washing machine or vacuum it off when needed, which makes life so much easier. I chose the XL size so my two female Malinois (one 55 lbs and the other 65 lbs) could share, and they fit perfectly together — it’s large and sturdy enough to support them both comfortably.Overall, this bed is functional, stylish, and practical, and the girls love it as much as I do. Highly recommend if you want something that looks good in your home and gives your dogs a comfy place to rest! I will probably buy another for our bedroom!
authors_reviews.author: Kyle crews

authors_reviews.title: Perfect Bed for My Fur Baby!
authors_reviews.text: The Lesure Orthopedic Dog Bed has been a fantastic purchase for my large dog! The egg crate foam provides amazing support, and I can tell my dog is much more comfortable, especially after a long day of play. The bed is thick and plush, yet firm enough to support his joints, making it perfect for dogs of all ages.The waterproof cover is a lifesaver for any accidents, and the removable design makes it so easy to clean—just unzip and toss it in the washer. I also love the chic cream color and fuzzy texture; it looks stylish in my home and feels super cozy for my dog.At 36" x 27", the size is perfect for my big girl to stretch out comfortably. She’s obsessed with her new bed and spends hours lounging on it! If you’re looking for a durable, high-quality dog bed that’s both functional and cute, this one is a winner. Highly recommend! 🐾
authors_reviews.author: Chastity

authors_reviews.title: Good quality, nice looking
authors_reviews.text: Very good quality, good cushion, cover is like a teddy bear and the color is as pictured. The size measured is larger than a crate, but it fits and looks good allowing for a littler "bumper" on each side--the dogs love them. Washing cover was easy. I would definitely purchase again.
authors_reviews.author: Dino Fett

authors_reviews.title: A big hit with our dogs!
authors_reviews.text: Great quality dog pillow with a soft, comfortable cover. The XL size works perfectly for our border collie and is still spacious enough for our larger lab. It’s also very stylish.
authors_reviews.author: Simone Brinkmann-Robinson

authors_reviews.title: Non-slip pet bed
authors_reviews.text: I purchased this bed to put beside our other for my two cats. It fit perfectly in the spot. While it is pretty decent quality, I don’t think it is as fluffy/thick, memory foam-like as the photos make it seem. I was a bit disappointed, but my cats immediately jumped on it so I’m happy if they’re happy. I do love the bottom that keeps the bed from slipping since they are constantly jumping on & off. Overall, I think it was a good purchase, but I think the price could be a little lower given the quality.
authors_reviews.author: Olivia P.

authors_reviews.title: FANTASTIC BED
authors_reviews.text: This is perfect for my medium-sized, geriatric (11 years old) lab. She weighs about 55 pounds and loves this bed for her sore, weak, and tired legs. She also leaked pee on it a few times and I can attest to the fact that it definitely is waterproof amd easy to wash, dry, and reassemble. Im very happy with this bed. It does run smaller, but it fits her well.
authors_reviews.author: Tosch Ranch

authors_reviews.title: Dog loves it
authors_reviews.text: My dog loves her bed for family time. We got new furniture and I put this between two recliners on a couch. My dog is always on it or using it as a pillow. The one weird thing is that after I washed the cover, it seemed smaller. The foam warped upwards like a bridge. It’s not super heavy foam or great quality but it’s fine for the price. Not sure what classifies something as orthopedic. The cover is ok- soft enough. The cover does prevent stains from getting on the foam. I gave it five stars because my dog loves it, it’s easy to clean, looks tidy with a nice neutral gray, and is a great price.
authors_reviews.author: MamaLlama

authors_reviews.title: Picky dog loves it
authors_reviews.text: We have an 80 lb German Shepherd. She has been picky about beds in the past but really likes this one. Bought it because of the removable cover and waterproof inner pad. So far no accidents from the dog so I haven’t had the waterproofing of the pad cover tested. Seems well made and very happy with it.
authors_reviews.author: Amazon Customer
